claims.statement: Management targets an EBITDA margin of 18.5% to 20% for the year, with higher margins expected in the second half.
claims.quote: So that's exactly what I had mentioned initially that in 18.5% to 20% that we're guiding, it will be more in the favor of H2 where you will have better than average
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects to achieve a $1 billion exit run rate for the US business.
claims.quote: We are talking about $1 billion exit. So this is about $380 million of incremental revenue.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets margins of 20% plus going forward into FY28.
claims.quote: To be fair, I think it should 20 plus is something that we should anyway sustain going forward.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects R&D expenses to continue at about 6% to 7%, leaning towards 7%.
claims.quote: R&D also, while it is discretionary and in hand, but still will continue to be at about 6% to 7%, but more biased towards 7% because we are increasing the number of programs, etcetera.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects a couple of upcoming product launches in the US to be $100 million plus annualized opportunities.
claims.quote: in terms of annualized revenues from these products, I think a couple of them, we are expecting $100 million plus annualized opportunities, right?
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management aims to develop roughly 6 to 8 biosimilars internally.
claims.quote: biosimilar side, where we would want to do roughly 6 to 8 internally.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management anticipates the current capex cycle to reduce after another year or so.
claims.quote: So this cycle will probably reduce after another year or so because we've built enough capacity for the products that we want to supply.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company has cash on its balance sheet that management considers to be quite large.
facts.quote: Actually just one clarification because the cash on balance sheet is pretty large now.

facts.statement: In the India business, the company executed in-licensing of Pfizer products and acquired a business named Inzpera.
facts.quote: Yes, we had in-licensing of some Pfizer products. We had a small acquisition of a business called Inzpera.

facts.statement: The company holds the number one position by volume in the India market.
